item.description: Trade buzz tied Vincent Trocheck to the Boston Bruins leading up to the deadline, but the deal never got close to happening. The reason has now become clear that the New York Rangers simply asked for far too much. item.title: Breaking News: NHL Reverses Forfeiture of Senators 1st-Round Pick for Dadonov Trade
item.description: The Ottawa Senators are breathing a big sigh of relief today, as the NHL has announced that the team will no longer lose their first-round pick in the 2026 Draft over the Evgenii Dadonov trade controversy of a few years back. Instead, the penalty has been revised so that the Sens will receive the 32nd and final pick of the first round and are not eligible for the Draft Lottery to change that position. item.description: Yes, we know the NHL trade deadline passed last Friday at 3:00pm Eastern.
